name: Assortion
summary: Shopify app for upsells, cross-sells, product add-ons and cart customization, with one feature set on every plan and a price set by the store's total monthly orders.
best_for: Shopify stores that want upsells, cross-sells, product add-ons and cart customization in one app at a flat price that grows with order volume rather than as a share of upsell revenue
skip_if: your store has many orders but low margins, since the price rises with every order whether or not an upsell sells; or you want upsell blocks outside the product page
honest_knock: The price follows your total store orders, so you pay the same whether the upsells sell or not, and busy months can push you into the next tier. App blocks only work on product pages. We found no refund or cancellation policy, and the page does not say how refunded orders or a tier change mid-month are handled.

pricing.entry_price_terms: 0-50 orders · per month, set by total monthly store orders, not only orders with an upsell
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-15 on assortion.com/pricing and the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/assortion, prices in USD) Assortion has one feature set and charges by the size of your store: the price depends on your total monthly store orders, not only the orders that include an upsell. 0 to 50 orders a month costs $9.99, 51 to 200 costs $19.99, 201 to 500 costs $34.99, 501 to 1,000 costs $59.99, 1,001 to 2,500 costs $89.99, 2,501 to 5,000 costs $149.99 and more than 5,000 costs $199.99. The two top tiers overlap at exactly 5,000 orders on the page. The Shopify listing shows only the first three tiers and bills every 30 days. Development stores use the app for free with all features. Paid plans list a 14-day free trial, cart customization, upsells, product add-ons and live support. No annual price is shown.

compare_with.name: Selleasy
compare_with.why: Selleasy is in our dossiers too and solves the same problem with a different meter: when we read it on 19 September 2026 it charged a share of the sales it helped make, 3% on direct sales, 1% on assisted sales and 5% on upsells and cross-sells, with no subscription. Assortion charges a fixed monthly price set by your total orders, from $9.99. If upsells drive a lot of revenue per order, a flat fee is easier to predict; if they sell little, a revenue share costs less.
